call_binding.binding: Bind positions, then exact keyword names; substitute in declaration order.
call_binding.boundary: No evaluated/mutable defaults, unpostponed annotations, type parameters, used variadics, extra arguments, unpacking, async/generator calls, external-rule keywords or non-normalized names.
call_binding.defaults: Omitted slots use source-free immutable scalars; explicit arguments override defaults. Definition-time effects stay unchecked.
call_binding.definitions: ASCII signatures and literal defaults defer bodies, including variadics. Annotations need a checked module-local future directive and at most 128 nodes. No annotation await, yield, assignment or type unpacking.
call_binding.evaluation: Evaluate explicit values once in source order before binding.
call_binding.initialization: Literals, aliases, built-in references, exports and plain classes/instances are inert. Reads, collisions and effects stay unchecked.
call_binding.invalid: Missing, excess, duplicate or unknown arguments leave analysis incomplete; no TypeError model.
call_binding.parameters: ASCII positional-only, positional-or-keyword and keyword-only slots; required or immutable literal defaults.
call_binding.variadics: Omit unused ASCII variadics whose names never occur in the body. Calls bind fixed slots; annotations follow definition rules.

expression_control.boundary: scalar truth and comparisons; no overloaded protocols or implicit exceptions.
expression_control.comparisons: ordered operands; each comparison result may be true or false.
expression_control.effects: join normal, sink and explicit-raise alternatives.
expression_control.evaluation: left-to-right; each operand once per expression transfer.
expression_control.selectors: Boolean and None literals, not, parentheses and nested selected expressions.
expression_control.unknowns: retain both alternatives; no variable or call-result truth specialization.

function_summaries.claim: may-value derivations in the declared model; neither feasible paths nor runtime termination.

function_summaries.effects: explicit scalar returns, sink contracts and explicit raises; no heap effects.
function_summaries.recursion: monotone least fixed point over finite origin and effect sets.
